nova.SHADOW VIRTUAL INTERFACES: The `SHADOW VIRTUAL INTERFACES` table holds shadow copies of virtual interface records. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, ADDRESS, NETWORK ID, UUID, INSTANCE UUID, DELETED.
nova.SHADOW VOLUME ID MAPPINGS: The `SHADOW VOLUME ID MAPPINGS` table holds shadow copies of volume UUID mappings. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, UUID, DELETED.
nova.SHADOW VOLUME USAGE CACHE: The `SHADOW VOLUME USAGE CACHE` table holds shadow copies of volume usage statistics. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, VOLUME ID, TOT LAST REFRESHED, TOT READS, TOT READ BYTES, TOT WRITES, TOT WRITE BYTES, CURR LAST REFRESHED, CURR READS, CURR READ BYTES, CURR WRITES, CURR WRITE BYTES, DELETED, INSTANCE UUID, PROJECT ID, USER ID, AVAILABILITY ZONE.
nova.SNAPSHOT ID MAPPINGS: The `SNAPSHOT ID MAPPINGS` table maps snapshot IDs to UUIDs. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, UUID, DELETED.
nova.SNAPSHOTS: The `SNAPSHOTS` table stores snapshot records for volumes. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, VOLUME ID, USER ID, PROJECT ID, STATUS, PROGRESS, VOLUME SIZE, SCHEDULED AT, DISPLAY NAME, DISPLAY DESCRIPTION, DELETED.
nova.TAGS: The `TAGS` table stores arbitrary tags associated with resources. Columns include: RESOURCE ID, TAG.
nova.TASK LOG: The `TASK LOG` table records task execution logs. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, TASK NAME, STATE, HOST, PERIOD BEGINNING, PERIOD ENDING, MESSAGE, TASK ITEMS, ERRORS, DELETED.
nova.VIRTUAL INTERFACES: The `VIRTUAL INTERFACES` table records virtual network interfaces attached to instances. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, ADDRESS, NETWORK ID, UUID, INSTANCE UUID, DELETED.
nova.VOLUME ID MAPPINGS: The `VOLUME ID MAPPINGS` table maps volume IDs to UUIDs. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, UUID, DELETED.
nova.VOLUME USAGE CACHE: The `VOLUME USAGE CACHE` table caches usage statistics for volumes. Columns include: CREATED AT, UPDATED AT, DELETED AT, ID, VOLUME ID, TOT LAST REFRESHED, TOT READS, TOT READ BYTES, TOT WRITES, TOT WRITE BYTES, CURR LAST REFRESHED, CURR READS, CURR READ BYTES, CURR WRITES, CURR WRITE BYTES, DELETED, INSTANCE UUID, PROJECT ID, USER ID, AVAILABILITY ZONE.
